items.frank_statement: Effect authority remains external to model output; host effects use explicit capabilities/permits with release-time revalidation and no ambient OS authority.
items.counterhypothesis: A simpler host ABI can use globally unique opaque resource IDs plus lexical borrow enforcement, so ClayCode need not expose generation/ownership fields in its canonical IR.
items.falsifier: A production lowering with a simpler representation passes stale-resource, cross-type, borrow-escape, replay and authority tests at equal or lower cost.

independent_checks.result: slot-only designation fails deliberate reuse; lifetime-bound typed identity passes tested corpus
independently uses typed resources with owned vs borrowed handles and call-bounded borrows
supports explicit host-granted capabilities rather than ambient authority

adversarial_checks: stale capability designation after slot reuse
items.reason: The external authority boundary survives independent checks, but FFI resource designation needs lifetime-safe identity or an equivalent mechanism. The exact five-field representation is not established.
items.claycode_action: Keep G9 CapabilityToken/EffectIntent authority separation; add an OPEN BASE FFI requirement that lowering binds capability designation to lifetime-bound typed resource identity and enforces owned/borrowed or equivalent lifetime semantics. Do not promote exact syntax yet.
